TROPION-PanTumor03 will investigate the safety, tolerability, and anti-tumour activity of Datopotamab Deruxtecan (Dato-DXd) as Monotherapy and in Combination with Anticancer Agents in Patients with Advanced/Metastatic Solid Tumours.

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] Study of BTK Inhibitor LOXO-305 Versus Approved BTK Inhibitor Drugs in Patients With Mantle Cell Lymphoma (MCL) (Phase 3, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT04662255 | Sponsor: Loxo Oncology, Inc. | Condition: Lymphoma, Mantle-Cell | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING. This is a study for participants with a type of blood cancer called mantle cell lymphoma (MCL). The main purpose is to compare pirtobrutinib (LOXO-305) to other drugs that work in a similar way that have already been approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration (US FDA). Participation could last up to two years, and possibly longer, if the disease does not progress.
